blogs.title: Bytes, Not Tokens: Why the New BLT Architecture Is a Game‑Changer
blogs.description: Break down the core idea of Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) and explain how ditching fixed vocabularies lets the model learn directly from raw bytes. Highlight the benefits – better robustness to noise, easier multilingual support, and a new way to think about tokenization.

blogs.title: Patch‑wise Scaling: How Dynamic Byte Patches Outperform Traditional Tokens
blogs.description: Describe BLT’s dynamic patching mechanism: entropy‑based byte grouping, space‑based rules, and strided patches. Show how larger, context‑aware patches let the model allocate compute exactly where it’s needed, leading to superior scaling compared to token‑based models.

blogs.title: Behind the Scenes of BLT’s Two‑Tier Transformer Design
blogs.description: Unpack BLT’s architecture: a lightweight local encoder/decoder that turns bytes into latent patches and a powerful global transformer that processes those patches. Explain cross‑attention, n‑gram hash embeddings, and the role of each module in balancing efficiency and performance.

blogs.title: Scaling LLMs on Raw Bytes: What the 8B BLT Experiment Reveals
blogs.description: Walk readers through the large‑scale training study—up to 8 B parameters and 4 T bytes—and compare BLT’s performance with tokenized baselines. Focus on why BLT holds its own (and sometimes outperforms) even under flop‑controlled regimes.

blogs.title: Robustness at the Byte Level: How BLT Beats Tokenized Models on Noisy Text
blogs.description: Showcase BLEU+ character‑level benchmarks (CUTE, G2P, FLORES‑101) where BLT shines. Explain how direct byte modeling enables stronger handling of misspellings, case shifts, and low‑resource language pairs—something tokenizers struggle with.

blogs.title: From Llama 3 to BLT: The Art of ‘Byte‑ifying’ a Pre‑Trained Model
blogs.description: Explore the distillation pipeline of initializing BLT with Llama 3 weights. Discuss how this approach speeds up convergence, retains performance gains, and offers a practical bridge for users wanting to experiment with byte‑level models without starting from scratch.

blogs.title: Future Directions for Byte‑Level LLMs – What’s Next for BLT?
blogs.description: Outline open research questions highlighted by the authors—end‑to‑end learning of patch boundaries, new scaling laws tailored to BLT, architectural tweaks at larger scales, and GPU/FPGA optimizations. Invite readers to imagine what the next generation of byte‑centric models might look like.
